replies.body:
I honestly don't think this is very useful. I think taking the extra 15-20 seconds to look at someone's name on the website is perfectly fine.

This is similar to the suggestion as to where if you click on a name during a report, you will instantly teleport to that player. They are both nice ideas, but taking the extra few seconds isn't going to hurt.

replies.author: MasterProX
replies.body: It's not really "being lazy" — I see it as wanting to be practical and efficient. Like you said, would you rather leave your game for two minutes to check online, or press five keys and see it in chat while you can keep playing? It's the same premise that the "/where" command (for donors) is predicated on; not crucial, but certainly more convenient than searching up someone's profile...
